interface.signature: def search(txt: str, pat: str) -> list[int]:

preconditions.description: Both txt and pat are strings.
The length of txt is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The length of pat is at least 1 and strictly less than the length of txt.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= idx <= len(txt) - len(pat) + 1 for idx in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every index in the returned list is a valid 1-based starting position where pat can fit within txt.

postconditions.expression: all(txt[idx - 1 : idx - 1 + len(pat)] == pat for idx in return_value)
postconditions.description: For every index in the returned list, the substring of txt starting at that 1-based index equals pat.
The returned list of indices is sorted in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len([i + 1 for i in range(len(txt) - len(pat) + 1) if txt[i : i + len(pat)] == pat])
postconditions.description: The returned list contains exactly all 1-based starting indices where pat occurs in txt, with no omissions or duplicates.
